correctness.rationale: GGJ Proposition 4.2 supplies m=3+r₃+r₂ for semigroup endomorphisms and n≥5. In each e-fiber the image point of e is a distinguished t-fixed point, and et=te=e preserves the fibers; t³=t limits components to height-one stars and leaf-decorated two-cycles. A size-j two-cycle has ⌊j/2⌋ unordered leaf-split types. Multisets first within and then across fibers give G−G₀ after omitting pairs with t²=t, and rank-two orbits lie in G₀. Analytically, Σj exp(−jx)=(2 sinh(x/2))^(−2)≤x^(−2); summing the log Q expansion gives c/t² with c=ζ(3)/2. The multiset logarithm is at most 2t^(−2)exp(ζ(2)/t+c/t²). At t=√((c+ε)/log n) this is o(n/√log n), yielding the stated Cauchy upper constant. Line 78 writes an equality where only an upper bound has been proved; replacing it by ≤ gives the needed conclusion with no change in the theorem. Taking t=2ζ(2)/log n instead for G₀ yields the stated rank-two bound. For L=⌊6√log n⌋ the number M of available types lies between L²/3 and L(L+1). The binomial pigeonhole bound gives T≥n³ at one common size s, since 12 log 2>3 and the denominator is polylogarithmic. The tighter upper bound s≤1+L²(L+1) in particular implies s≤648(log n)^(3/2) eventually. Padding by one smaller fiber preserves injectivity for each large integer n. The multiset lower bound gives log r₃≥n/(648√log n), dominating log(1+r₂) and proving m/r₃→1. Independent truncated product multiplication reproduces m(5), m(10), m(20), m(40)=35, 2880, 10998182, 30328785627967; replay with node /workspace/review-evidence/bounded-checks.js. This is a finite series check, not an independent generator classification or asymptotic proof.
residual_risks: No sharp leading constant or classification of all minimum generating sets is established.
